observations: Photo 0 shows a black rectangular games console held above a desk; it has a glossy upper panel, matte lower body, a disc slot on the left front, and a power button area on the right front. A television is visible in the background.

Photo 1 shows a black game controller resting on the same console; it has a central guide button, two analogue sticks, a D-pad, and coloured face buttons. A hand holds the left side of the controller.
Neither photo shows any game discs, cases, power adaptor, cables, or packaging.
Both photos carry a watermark reading "POSTED ON JIJI NWODIKA SOMTO".

claims.evidence: console and controller design match Xbox One in photos 0 and 1
no games visible in photos 0 or 1
seller's statement only; photos cannot show adaptor condition

risks.risk: Console does not power on because of the stated adaptor issue
risks.proof: video of the console turning on and reaching the home screen with the adaptor connected

risks.risk: Controller does not sync or buttons do not respond
risks.proof: video of the controller connecting to the console and all buttons being tested

risks.risk: Six games are not included or are damaged or non-working
risks.proof: photos of all six game cases and discs, ideally each disc being read by the console
risks.if_unproven: as console only with no games

risks.risk: Console has other faults such as disc drive failure or overheating
risks.proof: video of the console navigating menus and reading a disc

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on with the adaptor and reaching the home screen
Photos of all six game cases and discs
Video of the controller syncing and all buttons responding
Video of the console reading a game disc
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a games console with one controller from the photos; the seller's claims about games and the adaptor are unproven, so it is priced at its worst case as a non-working console with no games until proof is provided.
